label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Sungjae Im leads FedEx St. Jude
items.text: Sungjae Im sits atop the FedEx St. Jude Championship leaderboard at -6 through two holes, with Michael Thorbjornsen, Jordan Spieth, Kurt Kitayama, and Jake Knapp close behind at -5.

items.headline: Jon Rahm may leave LIV Golf
items.text: Jon Rahm is reportedly considering leaving LIV Golf in 2027 amid renewed fines and suspensions from the DP World Tour ahead of a potential Ryder Cup decision.

items.headline: Galdiano leads Portland Classic
items.text: Mariel Galdiano opened the Standard Portland Classic with a 7-under 65, holding a one-stroke lead after the first round at Columbia-Edgewater Country Club.
